You begin to recite a song of your choice that radiates illusory chakra that seeps into the psyche of creatures in range. Select the song you wish you recite when this jutsu is cast, each coming with its own set of effects for this jutsu’s duration as they must make an Intelligence saving throw at the beginning of each turn they begin within this jutsu’s radius. You can switch the tune at the beginning of each of your turns by spending a Bonus Action.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature suffers the songs effects.

Critical Failure: Affected creature suffers the songs effects plus the critical bonus.

Ancient Song. Hostile creatures who fail suffers a break of madness, attacking the closest creature to them on their turn until with lowest ranked jutsu. If they critically fail, they instead target themselves automatically scoring a hit.

Painful Song. Hostile creatures who fail experience extreme pain, losing the ability to cast jutsu with the Mobility (M) component. If they critically fail, they also fall Prone.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you use the Reversal Song. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can use the War Song.

Reversal Song. Hostile creatures who gain a bonus of any type from a jutsu, become unable to benefit from those bonuses. If they critically fail, those bonuses become penalties.

War Song. Hostile creatures suffer a -2 penalty to AC and Saving throws. If they critically fail, the penalty extends to all rolls that include dice as well.

You force your palms together before pointing them towards the sky, pulling down or manifesting star like constructs that encircle you in any description you desire. As part of casting this jutsu, you may select 4 spaces within 60 feet of you that you can see, firing a star into each. You may not select the same space more than once. Stars radiate 10-feet of bright light and an additional 10-feet of dim light, dissipating at the beginning of your next turn.

Objects, creatures and structures in the selected spaces where a star is directed take 1d12 force damage. A creature, object or structure occupying multiple spaces in which a star has fallen, takes the damage of each of these stars no more than twice per casting.

As an action on following turns, you may select two more spaces, sending stars to occupy them, after which they dissipate at the beginning of your next turn.

The space the target creature is in radiates light as if a star was directed to occupy the space.

If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you can increase the number of spaces selected or creatures that can be targeted by +2. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank its duration becomes Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You lose all remaining Royal Shield charges after using this effect.

description.value:
“She doesn’t look like much, I can do this alone.” came the mercenary's voice as he joked with his allies, while looking at the frail young girl whose face was mostly obscured by her oddly tall collar. “You look lost girl, you sure you’re in the right place? Maybe we can help you out” he says in a crude tone. The lone girl points with a single hand outstretched “Your allies look like they could use your help more than me.” she says in a monotone manner causing the mercenary to look back at his two allies who look drained and almost mummified from the way their skin sits on almost exposed bone. He shrieks out in confusion before he notices that insects of different shapes and sizes are slowly covering his body. He tries to run but falls before being covered in the swarm of insects not even able to yell out in retaliation. “People always underestimate the little ones, it's always the little ones you overestimate. Isn’t that right slim?”  The girl says while looking at a centipede on her finger.

—Tatsunami Aburame.

The Long Road, Ch. 11 excerpt.

A Forest sectioned off exclusively for them in the leaf village, with homes built exclusively in the tree’s and partially in the Earth itself. The sounds of insects moving and the smells of moist Earth and rotting trees. And the defining characteristic of insects living inside them, are the threads that tie all Aburame together.

Creepy Crawly

The Aburame Clan is one of the four noble clans of the leaf village. At birth, members of this clan are offered to several special breeds of insects as a nest, residing just under their host's skin. These insects will then live-in symbiosis with their host from that point on. Because of this, its members are characterized by their use of insects as weapons through use of their Insect based Ninjutsu.

The insects can leave and enter their host's body through various pores. They feed on Chakra as a food source, making them quite deadly. The relationship between the shinobi and the insects is mutually beneficial.

A major defining trait of the Aburame clan is that all of its known members' eyes are obscured usually by glasses, as well as they wear clothing that usually cover up most of their body.

Aburame Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Intelligence, +1 Wisdom

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiencies: Nature, Animal Handling

Extra Language: Insect-Speak, you can understand and speak to insects.

Aburame Hijutsu: The Aburame Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Aburame Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Aburame Features

Symbiotic Hive

1st Level Clan Feature

You are never alone. Beneath the skin, a quiet colony drinks from your chakra and answers your will. You can release or recall a swarm of symbiotic insects as a Bonus action entering your Swarm Chakra stance.

While released you gain the benefits of the chosen Swarm types below. If you fall unconscious or take fire damage the swarm automatically recalls back to you.

Select one of the following Swarm types at character creation. You gain one additional selection at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. Your chosen swarm types provide you benefits while the swarm is inactive, and boosted benefits while it is active.

Ants

You can transmit whispered messages through your insects to one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Only that creature can hear you.

While your Swarm is active, when you deal damage to a creature with a Hijutsu you can mark them with a messenger ant, which remains until the end of your next turn. While marked in this way, the ant releases a pheromone for your allies, granting the next creature of your choice that targets them, a rank of Mastery on their next attack. The ant falls off afterwards ending this effect.

Beetles

As a reaction to taking damage, your beetles coalesce around you forming a chitin shield, granting you DR equal to 1d4 + your highest casting ability modifier. This increases to 1d6 at 7th and 1d8 at 15th levels.

While your Swarm is active, you can take this reaction in response to an allied creature within 20 feet of you that takes damage. When you do, you apply the effects to them.

Flies

You gain a rank of Mastery when using the Search or Track skill-based actions while in a forest, swamp or urban terrain.

While your Swarm is active, you can generate a 20-foot cube of swarming flies that acts like a cloud as part of releasing your swarm, centered on a point your space is touching that moves with you. Spaces inside the affected area is lightly obscured and attacks against creatures of your choice within the area from creatures outside the area is made at disadvantage. You can dismiss the cloud on your turn, at no action cost. But remanifesting it costs a bonus action.

Larva

| Festering Brood – Infested / [Physical] / Your body has been infiltrated by a small colony of carnivorous insects. Infested is treated as a physical condition. / While Infested, Increase the cost of jutsu you cast by +4 for each rank of infested you have. / If enhanced, instead, increase the chakra cost by +6 for each rank. / While Infested, you gain a -2 penalty to Strength and Dexterity saving throws. / If enhanced, the affected creature suffers the same penalty to their jutsu save DC’s. / An Infested creature can make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC at the end of each of their turns to remove the infestation on a success. |

You can rest inside of a human sized cocoons and can be used as a Sleeping bag allowing you to rest like a rejuvenating insect during a Short Rest. Increase the hit and chakra points regained for each Hit and Chakra die spent by +4.

Mosquitoes

When a creature within 15 feet of you takes damage from an attack you make or a jutsu you cast, you deal an additional +2 necrotic damage. This increases to 30 feet at 7th and +4 necrotic damage at 15th level.

While your Swarm is active when your attack result is 5 or higher than a targets AC or an affected creature fails by 5 or more, you regain 1d6 hit points. This increases to 2d6 at 7th and 3d6 at 15th level.

Moths

You are always hovering roughly 1 foot off the ground when moving. If you take the Dash action, you gain a fly speed equal to the speed granted by the Dash action.

While your Swarm is active, you gain a fly speed equal to half of your movement speed. While flying, if you would fall, you can spend your reaction to slow your decent, taking no falling damage when you reach the ground.

Worms

While you are on solid ground, you gain 15 feet of Tremor sense.

While your Swarm is active, you gain a Burrowing speed equal to half of your movement speed. While burrowing, you leave behind a tunnel large enough for one creature to fit through.

Parasites

You can learn and cast Jutsu with the Medical keyword.

While your Swarm is active, use the enhanced effects of the Infested condition.

Kikaichu Swarm

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your swarm can now act as a primary or secondary attack option when you will it.

When you take the Attack action, you can make a Kikaichu Swarm attack in place of any number of attacks made as part of that action. When you reach 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack feature, you can attack twice with this attack, instead of once. If you score a critical hit with this attack the affected creature gains 1 rank of Infested.

Kikaichu Swarm. Make a melee or ranged Jutsu attack (you can choose which Jutsu attack this uses; Ninjutsu, Genjutsu or Taijutsu) against a creature you can see. On a hit, you deal the listed damage based on if the attack was melee or ranged. If you roll a 6 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you gain temporary chakra equal to the damage dealt. This is treated as casting a D-Rank Jutsu with the Hijutsu keyword. This attacks damage die increases in size as you grow in level: 1d8 at 7th, 1d10 at 11th and 1d12 at 15th.

Melee: 2d6 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Poison (or Chakra, your choice) damage.

Ranged: 60 feet, 1d6 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Poison (or Chakra, your choice) damage.

Festering Brood

7th Level Clan Feature

Your army of insects are at your command, draining the life from your foes.

Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature as a result of a Jutsu you cast, you can attempt to have your insects infiltrate their body, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs the jutsu’s save DC (If the jutsu forces a saving throw, use their result on the jutsu’s saving throw to determine this features effects. On a failed save, they become Infested if it didn’t already.

Deceptive Swarm

11th Level Clan Feature

Your swarm has memorized the human anatomy and can now deceive even trained sensory types when needed.

Creatures that would attempt to sense or see you with Chakra Sense or Chakra Sight, cannot tell you apart from that of an insects chakra.

If you have your Hive out, willing creatures within 10 feet of you benefit from this effect as well.

Grand Veil

15th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to release your collective hive in full. Buzzing thickens the air; sight becomes a luxury and every step through the cloud feels like a mistake.

You can release your Swarm at the beginning of your turn, at no action cost. While your swarm is out, you can perform either of the following special abilities, once per rest.

Plague Swarm. As an action, you generate a 20-foot radius cloud centered on a point you can see within 60 feet for the duration of your Swarm. Creatures of your choice that are inside or entering the cloud treat the area as obscured and difficult terrain. Yourself and allies you can see are not hindered by your own cloud. Creatures of your choice who begin or end their turn in the cloud or enter it for the first time on a turn, gain 2 ranks of Infested. Creature with ranks of Infested cannot make a saving throw to end it if they begin or end their turn in the cloud until the end of their next turn. You can move your cloud 20 feet as a bonus action on your turn.

Queen’s Call. As an Action, you select one creature you can see within 60 feet of you and mark them with the queens decree as they are swarmed by your horde of insects. For the next minute, the marked creature suffers a -2 penalty to their AC and a -2 penalty to their saving throws from Aburame Hijutsu you cast. The penalty is treated as -1 for each for all non Aburame Hijutsu you cast.

You spread hungry insects around you in an attempt to greatly confuse those who rely on sensory based techniques.

You cannot cast this jutsu unless you are obscured in some way.

Select a number of spaces equal to your Ninjutsu ability modifier within 60 feet of you as you spread insects filled with your chakra.

You then suppress your chakra, gaining the benefit of a successful Suppress Chakra skill-based action and then make a Stealth, Ninshou or Illusions check vs the passive perception of all hostile creatures that are aware of you. On a success, you become hidden from them.

For the duration, creatures with Chakra Sense or Chakra Sight struggle to see through the constant pinging of chakra from each of these locations. You become invisible to creatures benefiting from these senses, and they cannot see you unless they deactivate their special senses and attempt to see you with normal vision.

You lay a trap with your insects, preparing for your enemies to cross a line. Select a point you can see within range. This point radiates a 10-foot radius trigger range that is invisible to all but you. If a hostile creature moves into or out of a space affected by your trap, then it triggers. Creatures in the affected area that don’t move cannot trigger this trap. This trap lasts for 1 hour and requires you to be within 120 feet of it to trigger.

When this trap is triggered all creatures of your choice within the affected area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save they take 4d6 poison (or Chakra, your choice) damage and are restrained for the next minute and this jutsu then requires concentration to maintain.

While restrained in this way an affected creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, retaking the damage on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, its radius size is increases by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, its radius size is increased by +5 feet.

Cost/concentration connected; effects manual. Higher-rank modes require manual resolution.

description.value:
1st Level Clan Feature

You are never alone. Beneath the skin, a quiet colony drinks from your chakra and answers your will. You can release or recall a swarm of symbiotic insects as a Bonus action entering your Swarm Chakra stance.

While released you gain the benefits of the chosen Swarm types below. If you fall unconscious or take fire damage the swarm automatically recalls back to you.

Select one of the following Swarm types at character creation. You gain one additional selection at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. Your chosen swarm types provide you benefits while the swarm is inactive, and boosted benefits while it is active.

Ants

You can transmit whispered messages through your insects to one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Only that creature can hear you.

While your Swarm is active, when you deal damage to a creature with a Hijutsu you can mark them with a messenger ant, which remains until the end of your next turn. While marked in this way, the ant releases a pheromone for your allies, granting the next creature of your choice that targets them, a rank of Mastery on their next attack. The ant falls off afterwards ending this effect.

Beetles

As a reaction to taking damage, your beetles coalesce around you forming a chitin shield, granting you DR equal to 1d4 + your highest casting ability modifier. This increases to 1d6 at 7th and 1d8 at 15th levels.

While your Swarm is active, you can take this reaction in response to an allied creature within 20 feet of you that takes damage. When you do, you apply the effects to them.

Flies

You gain a rank of Mastery when using the Search or Track skill-based actions while in a forest, swamp or urban terrain.

While your Swarm is active, you can generate a 20-foot cube of swarming flies that acts like a cloud as part of releasing your swarm, centered on a point your space is touching that moves with you. Spaces inside the affected area is lightly obscured and attacks against creatures of your choice within the area from creatures outside the area is made at disadvantage. You can dismiss the cloud on your turn, at no action cost. But remanifesting it costs a bonus action.

Larva

Infested is treated as a physical condition. / While Infested, Increase the cost of jutsu you cast by +4 for each rank of infested you have. / If enhanced, instead, increase the chakra cost by +6 for each rank. / While Infested, you gain a -2 penalty to Strength and Dexterity saving throws. / If enhanced, the affected creature suffers the same penalty to their jutsu save DC’s. / An Infested creature can make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC at the end of each of their turns to remove the infestation on a success. |

You can rest inside of a human sized cocoons and can be used as a Sleeping bag allowing you to rest like a rejuvenating insect during a Short Rest. Increase the hit and chakra points regained for each Hit and Chakra die spent by +4.

Mosquitoes

When a creature within 15 feet of you takes damage from an attack you make or a jutsu you cast, you deal an additional +2 necrotic damage. This increases to 30 feet at 7th and +4 necrotic damage at 15th level.

While your Swarm is active when your attack result is 5 or higher than a targets AC or an affected creature fails by 5 or more, you regain 1d6 hit points. This increases to 2d6 at 7th and 3d6 at 15th level.

Moths

You are always hovering roughly 1 foot off the ground when moving. If you take the Dash action, you gain a fly speed equal to the speed granted by the Dash action.

While your Swarm is active, you gain a fly speed equal to half of your movement speed. While flying, if you would fall, you can spend your reaction to slow your decent, taking no falling damage when you reach the ground.

Worms

While you are on solid ground, you gain 15 feet of Tremor sense.

While your Swarm is active, you gain a Burrowing speed equal to half of your movement speed. While burrowing, you leave behind a tunnel large enough for one creature to fit through.

Parasites

You can learn and cast Jutsu with the Medical keyword.

While your Swarm is active, use the enhanced effects of the Infested condition.

description.value:
“You don’t quite understand the situation you're in...do you boy?” Haizo bellowed out from the darkness he created with his Ninjutsu. “The Darkness is my ally, while you skulk through it, I was born of it. I have made it my partner in battle.” He speaks in a tone of assured victory, guaranteed of his success, his acute senses allow him to feel where his target is, a boy of average height who looks remarkably slim with long dark hair. Haizo begins to make his assault final as he rushes towards the boy who has been standing remarkably still the entire time. As Haizo enters striking range the boy reacts with monstrous precision striking Haizo in multiple points across his torso in the blink of an eye dispersing the Jutsu he had up, allowing light to shower the two. “But how!? It was total Darkness how did you know where I would strike!?” Haizo cried out. The boy stared at him, eyes pale white with veins running across his face leading both too and from his eyes as they stare almost through Haizo. “You overestimated yourself and underestimated my Byakugan, that was your fatal mistake” the boy said with a grin that would infuriate even the most composed of men.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 3 excerpt.

The Villages Strongest

The Hyūga Clan is one of the four noble clans of Konoha as well as the strongest clan in the village. All members born into this clan possess the Byakugan, a bloodline trait that gives them extended fields of vision and the ability to see through solid objects and even the Chakra circulatory system, amongst other things. Members of this clan also possess an innate ability which allows them to excel Chakra from any of the Tenketsu in their body. They are considered to be one of, if not currently, the most powerful clan in Konoha. Their fame and prowess stretch far and wide, leading others to both praise and covet their abilities.

The clan is separated into two parts: the main house and the branch house, a system that protects the secrets of the Byakugan from outsiders. The main house runs the family while the branch house protects it.

Hyūga Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis, +1 Dex

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Perception, Martial Arts

Dark Vision: Even without the power of a fully active Byakugan, you have Darkvision up to 30 feet.

Hyūga Hijutsu: The Hyūga Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Hyūga Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Branch Family: The Hyuga are split between two different branches, the [Main Branch] and the [Side Branch]. The [Main Branch] acts as the nobles of the clan while the [Side Branch], the warriors or guardians. Select which branch your character is a part of. This determines some clan features or which Hijutsu you gain/have access to. This cannot be changed later.

Hyūga Features

Byakugan

1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the hidden Leaf village’s 2 great Dojutsu. The Byakugan is the All-seeing white eye. You may, as a bonus action you can activate this Dojutsu, which remains active for up to 10 minutes at a time, after which you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again. While active the Byakugan gains the following benefits:

All Seeing White Eye: You have 120 feet of Chakra Sight while out of combat and 60 feet while in combat. You can see through material up to 1 feet thick when taking the Search action. This perceptive strength grows at 7th level when you can see through material up to 5 feet thick within your chakra sight range. Your vision increases again at 11th level, granting you 500 feet of chakra sight outside of combat and 120 feet while in combat.

360° Vision: You can see in a 360-degree field around you without having to turn your head or avert your gaze. Creatures cannot be hidden from you without being Heavily obscured or behind total cover.

Gentle Fist

1st Level Clan Feature

In addition to the Byakugan, the Hyuga are known for their Gentle Fist stance. The Gentle Fist is the premiere fighting style for the Hyūga clan.

Also at 1st level, you learn the Taijutsu Stance of the Hyuga Clan, allowing you to use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility while in this stance to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d8. This becomes 2d8 at 11th level.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Chakra or Necrotic which you choose when you roll damage.

Your Hijutsu gain their Eight Trigram effect.

Beginning at 7th level, when you deal chakra damage to a creature with 0 chakra, you instead deal double the result as force damage to their hit points.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Bloodline of the Elite

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your training with the secrets of the Hyuga has allotted you a plethora of abilities that help shape your technique and fighting style. Select 2 Hyuga Dogma’s which exemplify your skill within the clan. You gain one additional choice at 11th level.

Combat Insight

You gain amazing combat senses with or without your Byakugan. As a bonus action, while observing a creature, you can make an Identify (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu or Taijutsu/Bukijutsu, pick one) check against a creature you can see, vs their Level DC. On a success, you are able to learn of any one special action or ability they have that would qualify as or is similar to, the associated check.

Wisdom of the Court

The Hyuga are not jutsu warriors or martial artists. They are the Land of Fires most premier shinobi royalty. With this status comes the wisdom of managing such social circles. You can use Wisdom in place of Charisma for Persuasion and Intimidation checks.

Predictive Perception

Your ability to intuit danger, has been honed to near perfection. When a creature would make an attack against you at advantage, you can spend your reaction making them instead roll at disadvantage and gaining a rank of Mastery to your AC for the attack.

Sensory Type

As an Action, while exploring with your Byakugan active, you can perform a Perimeter Sweep ability. When you do, for the next 10 minutes, you and allied creatures with you, gain a rank of mastery to the next saving throw made against a triggered trap.

Cold Calculations

The clan has taught you to be practical, cold and calculative in all things. When you complete a long rest, you gain the Cold Calculus special action.

Cold Calculus. This special action can be used in place of your normal action or reaction for any Hyuga Hijutsu that requires it. Once this special action has been used, you cannot regain it until you complete a long rest.

Illusion Fist

A little-known secret of the Byakugan is that, when Genjutsu is focused through it, it becomes more focused, light sunlight though a magnifying glass. While in the Gentle Fist Stance, you can choose to make melee Genjutsu attacks, in place of unarmed attacks. These attacks, deal psychic damage when made this way.

Additionally, if you cast a Hyuga Hijutsu with Wisdom, you can change its damage type to Psychic, but counts as chakra or necrotic for other Hyuga clan features.

Tenketsu Needle

Once per turn, when you deal chakra damage to a creature with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion, increase the chakra damage dealt by +2. This increases to +4 at 11th level.

Eight Trigrams – Sealing Technique

7th Level Clan Feature

[Main Branch]

The iconic fighting style of the Hyuga, doesn’t stop at just your martial arts, but in all forms of chakra-based warfare. When you cast a Jutsu that deals Chakra damage or has the Fuinjutsu keyword, you manifest the mythical Eight Trigrams sigil as part of its casting. Once per casting, one of the affected creatures that would attempt to cast a jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failure, their jutsu’s casting is Interrupted and gains a rank of Network Distortion.

Eight Trigrams – Internal Assault

7th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

The iconic fighting style of the Hyuga, doesn’t stop at just your martial arts, but in all forms of chakra-based warfare. When you cast a Jutsu that deals necrotic damage or has the Medical keyword, you manifest the mythical Eight Trigrams sigil as part of its casting. Once per casting, one of the affected creatures that would attempt to cast a jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failure, they trigger the seal you placed as they gain 3 ranks of Network Distortion.

Eight Trigrams – Palm Bottom

11th Level Clan Feature

[Main Branch]

Your strikes are refined by the focus instilled into you by the main branch. Your strikes reaches deep into your foe, bludgeoning their internal organs. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save the affected creature is Staggered. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Eight Trigrams – Gentle End

11th Level Clan Feature

[Side Branch]

Your strike are efficient brutal, refined by the aggression instilled into you by the side branch. Your strike reaches deep into your foe, causing server internal damage. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature as a result of the Attack action with ranks of Sealed or Network Distortion you can dispel all ranks they have forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest save DC. On a failed save the affected creature takes 1d6 necrotic and chakra damage for every rank dispelled in this way. They suffer a -1 penalty to their save for every 2 ranks of either condition dispelled in total. Once your use this feature you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Heavenly Technique

15th Level Clan Feature

You take a single breath sharpening your Gentle Fist stance making each strike more precise and lethal than the last, making each strike accurately bludgeon the internal organs of your foes. You can assume this enhanced battle stance for one minute, after which you require a rest before you can use it again. For the duration you gain the following benefits:

Chakra damage you deal ignore DR (Damage reduction.)

When you make an unarmed attack that deals chakra damage, you deal an equal amount of damage to the target as Necrotic damage. If you would deal Force damage as a result of the target having 0 chakra, you instead simply double the necrotic damage you deal.

Each successful attack you make in the same turn, that deals Chakra or Necrotic damage increases the cost of the next Jutsu the affected creature casts by +2.

Chakra damage you deal ignore DR (Damage reduction.)

When you make an unarmed attack that deals chakra damage, you deal an equal amount of damage to the target as Necrotic damage. If you would deal Force damage as a result of the target having 0 chakra, you instead simply double the necrotic damage you deal.

Each successful attack you make in the same turn, that deals Chakra or Necrotic damage increases the cost of the next Jutsu the affected creature casts by +2.

description.value:
The Genin stands on top of one of tallest tree’s just outside of the Leaf village. She claps her hands together focusing. The tree begins to shake, as it grows, slightly. She stops as she realized she was already higher than the canopy. She hears the voice of someone below her. “Hey! Tsunanami, you sure you’re not over doing it?” The Girl standing on the tree, falls to the ground, taking the snacks the other girl brought her. “No, I think I’m making progress. Just this morning, this tree was only to my ankle. Now Look at its Tallest tree in this part of the forest. Sooner or later. I’m going to make this the tallest tree in the world!”

—Yuki Hyūga

At Worlds End, Ch. 13 excerpt.

The Leaf’s Patriarchs

The Senju Clan is a clan that hails proudly from the Land of Fire and is one of its founders. So deeply ingrained and influential, that three of the Leaf Villages Hokage have been Senju, bringing about a new era of prosperity for the leaf each time. Using Mokuton (or Wood release), a user is extremely versatile and able to control, restrict and even seal away an opponent’s Chakra. The power of Wood Release, and by extension the Senju are widely known, so much so that they were heralded as the strongest clan during the Warring states era.

Senju Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou.

Wood Release Affinity: You begin with either Earth or Water Release Affinity. (Pick one)

Mokuton Release Techniques: The Senju Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Senju Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Senju Features

Built Different

1st Level Clan Feature

The Senju are known for their inhuman stamina and vitality. Increase your Hit Point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your hit point total by 2.

Additionally, this well of vitality coalesces within you as latent self-restoring energies. You have a well of these healing energies called Senju Cells, of which you have 2.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated, you can call upon this healing energy and spend 1 Senju Cell. When you do, roll 1d6 + your half your level, minimum 1. You regain hit points equal to the result. You regain spent Senju Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 4. Also, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Senju Cell to end any one Physical or Elemental condition you have.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 6. Also, if you begin your turn with 0 hit points, you can spend any number of Senju Cells to spend an equal number of Hit Die, regaining hit points equal to the result.

Mokuton Infusion

1st Level Clan Feature

While the blood of the Senju runs through you, the heritage of one burns brightest. You have access to the unique Mokuton Kekkei Genkai and it suffuses itself throughout your already varied forms of combat. This is represented by your Mokuton Infusion Chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this Chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

You can enter the Mokuton Infusion stance as a bonus action, when you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns.

Will of the Buddha. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

When you take the attack action while you wield a Combat Scroll you can choose to instead make Verdant Lash attacks. You can replace each attack you would make as part of the Attack action with a Verdant Lash attack.

Verdant Lash. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, lashing out with bramble strikes. On a hit, you deal the listed melee or ranged damage. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you inflict 1 rank of Drained and push or pull them 10 feet closer or further from you. This increases to 15 feet, 2 ranks of Drained and this attack is treated as casting a D-Rank Hijutsu at 7th level. Increase the damage dealt by +1 damage die at 11th level. Starting at 15th level, increase the ranks of Drained inflicted to 3.

Melee: 1d10 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d10 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Fist of Hevajra. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Cold, Earth or Chakra which you choose when you roll damage.

Your unarmed attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility trait to calculate its attack and damage rolls.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 weapon property as your strikes are followed by branching wood strikes. This increases to Reach 2 at 7th level.

Verdant Bloodline

| Mokuton Infusion – Drained / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical], [Mental] / A Drained creature takes 1d8 chakra damage at the start of each of their turns for each rank it has. / A Drained creature increases the chakra damage they take from hostile creatures attacks or jutsu by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level. / A Drained creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Constitution ability check to end this condition. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your link to green isn’t an accident. Your chakra doesn’t just build, it grows, sprouts and reveals its beauty and strength. You can control wood and nature like its second nature. Once per turn as part of an attack made with the Attack action while in your Mokuton Infusion stance or when casting a Senju Hijutsu, you can use the New Growth ability.

New Growth. Select a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you as you manifest a 10-foot radius patch of almost sentient foliage such as roots, trunks or brambles. Creatures other than you that move through this affected area spends 4 feet for movement for every 1 feet they move as they try to maneuver through this terrain. This special terrain is named New Growth and lasts for 1 minute or until cleared as a result of a damaging effect crossing affected spaces.

Wood Release

7th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting Wood Release due to their close affinity to both Earth and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Wood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or cold respectively.

Additionally, once per turn, as a Bonus action, by selecting one creature you can see within 30 feet of you that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or has ranks of Drained. You force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 20 feet closer or pushed 20 feet further away from you on a failed save.

Blood of the leaf

11th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for communication and negotiating hostile terms. While you are in communication with a non-allied creature, and they make a request of you. If you attempt to intimidate them in response, you gain 2 ranks of Mastery to the check.

Verdant Domain

15th Level Clan Feature

You are one with the wood. You are the commander of the green. All things in nature are part of your domain. Hostile creatures of your choice that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or are standing in an area under the effects of the New Growth special terrain has their chakra network impeded. When a hostile creature with an impeded chakra network casts a Jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) of a rank higher than the listed rank based on their classification, they gain ranks of Drained for every rank above the listed rank that they cast the triggering jutsu at.

Standard: D-Rank

Elite: C-Rank

Solo: B-Rank

The Senju are known for their inhuman stamina and vitality. Increase your Hit Point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your hit point total by 2.

Additionally, this well of vitality coalesces within you as latent self-restoring energies. You have a well of these healing energies called Senju Cells, of which you have 2.

Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated, you can call upon this healing energy and spend 1 Senju Cell. When you do, roll 1d6 + your half your level, minimum 1. You regain hit points equal to the result. You regain spent Senju Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 4. Also, at the beginning of your turn, you can spend 1 Senju Cell to end any one Physical or Elemental condition you have.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Senju Cells you have to 6. Also, if you begin your turn with 0 hit points, you can spend any number of Senju Cells to spend an equal number of Hit Die, regaining hit points equal to the result.

description.value:
1st Level Clan Feature

While the blood of the Senju runs through you, the heritage of one burns brightest. You have access to the unique Mokuton Kekkei Genkai and it suffuses itself throughout your already varied forms of combat. This is represented by your Mokuton Infusion Chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this Chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

You can enter the Mokuton Infusion stance as a bonus action, when you do, select one of its variants. You can swap between these variants by spending a bonus action on subsequent turns.

Will of the Buddha. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

When you take the attack action while you wield a Combat Scroll you can choose to instead make Verdant Lash attacks. You can replace each attack you would make as part of the Attack action with a Verdant Lash attack.

Verdant Lash. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, lashing out with bramble strikes. On a hit, you deal the listed melee or ranged damage. If you roll an 8 or higher on the damage die of this attack, you inflict 1 rank of Drained and push or pull them 10 feet closer or further from you. This increases to 15 feet, 2 ranks of Drained and this attack is treated as casting a D-Rank Hijutsu at 7th level. Increase the damage dealt by +1 damage die at 11th level. Starting at 15th level, increase the ranks of Drained inflicted to 3.

Melee: 1d10 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d10 Earth, Cold or Chakra damage.

Fist of Hevajra. While in this variant stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes Cold, Earth or Chakra which you choose when you roll damage.

Your unarmed attacks can use your Hijutsu Flexibility trait to calculate its attack and damage rolls.

Your unarmed attacks gain the Reach 1 weapon property as your strikes are followed by branching wood strikes. This increases to Reach 2 at 7th level.

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your link to green isn’t an accident. Your chakra doesn’t just build, it grows, sprouts and reveals its beauty and strength. You can control wood and nature like its second nature. Once per turn as part of an attack made with the Attack action while in your Mokuton Infusion stance or when casting a Senju Hijutsu, you can use the New Growth ability.

New Growth. Select a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you as you manifest a 10-foot radius patch of almost sentient foliage such as roots, trunks or brambles. Creatures other than you that move through this affected area spends 4 feet for movement for every 1 feet they move as they try to maneuver through this terrain. This special terrain is named New Growth and lasts for 1 minute or until cleared as a result of a damaging effect crossing affected spaces.

15th Level Clan Feature

You are one with the wood. You are the commander of the green. All things in nature are part of your domain. Hostile creatures of your choice that are Grappled or Restrained as a result of a Senju Hijutsu or are standing in an area under the effects of the New Growth special terrain has their chakra network impeded. When a hostile creature with an impeded chakra network casts a Jutsu that requires chakra molding (CM) of a rank higher than the listed rank based on their classification, they gain ranks of Drained for every rank above the listed rank that they cast the triggering jutsu at.

Standard: D-Rank

Elite: C-Rank

Solo: B-Rank

7th Level Clan Feature

The Senju clan has a unique talent for manifesting Wood Release due to their close affinity to both Earth and Water Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Wood Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Earth or Water release keywords, you can change the damage type to Earth or cold respectively.

You force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw, being pulled 20 feet closer or pushed 20 feet further away from you on a failed save.

description.value:
You manifest a large surge of your vitality, that you then inject into the foliage deep in the ground. Select a point you can see within range on the same surface as yourself. A massive tree, 90-feet tall and 30-feet wide, made of roots, erupts upwards attempting to capture all creatures in its path. This tree counts as an Earthen Artifact.

All creatures whose space would overlap with the tree must make a Strength saving throw, being restrained on a failed save, as the tree captures and binds them inside it. On a successful save, they escape the binding of the tree’s roots.

Creatures who failed the saving throw gain 3 ranks of Drained, have total cover from all creatures both inside and outside the tree and begin to feel immense pressure, as the tree begins to compress and feed off of their biological mass as nutrients. Restrained creatures take 6d8 Earth and Chakra damage at the beginning of each of their turns.

A restrained creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns and must pass their saving throw twice to escape this jutsu’s effects. Alternatively, if the tree takes 100 damage, it is destroyed, freeing all captured creatures.

A creature who’s hit points reach 0 while under the effects of this jutsu becomes a part of the tree.

Wood Clones have 10 Hit points, 10 Temporary hit points and 10 DR against the first instance of damage they take per turn.

They can only provide the benefit of the help action to their summoner.

Wood Clones can make up to 2 attacks when you command it to make a Clone Strike.

Wood Clones add your Ninjutsu ability modifier in earth damage to the damage they deal.

Wood Clones can cast Senju Hijutsu you know of C-Rank.

description.value:
1st Level Clan Feature

Mutated Feature: Mokuton Infusion

Beginning at 1st level, you become a shinobi capable of fighting with an Uchiha with nothing more than grit, skill and a bit of clever tricks. You gain access to a selection of Elite Tactics. Select two when you gain this mutation. You gain another selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Unbreakable

Select an ability score. You gain a Rank of Mastery to saving throws with the chosen saving throw. You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects.

Energizing

Once per turn, as a Bonus action, you can passively activate the healing capabilities of a willing creature. A creature you touch rolls 1 hit die without spending it, regaining hit points equal to the result + their constitution modifier. This increases to 2 hit die at 7th and 3 hit die at 15th level. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.

Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can help cleans 1 rank of any Physical or Elemental condition a creature is suffering from by attempting the check associated with the condition. If no check is associated, make a DC 12 Constitution ability check, ending 1 rank of the associated condition. For every +2 over the DC, remove +1 additional rank. A creature can be healed in this way only twice per rest.

Unfaltering

Select two conditions from the following list. You gain resistance to the chosen conditions. You can select this Tactic a second time, repeating this tactics effects;

Burned, Chilled, Corroded, Shocked, Envenomed, Bruised, Staggered, Bleed, Dazed, Shaken, Weakened, Concussed or Exhausted.

Rallying Figure

When you or an allied creature you can see fails a saving throw, you can spend your reaction forcing the target to remake their saving throw. If they succeed, you regain 1 Senju Cell.

Legacy of the Second

You can learn jutsu with the Water Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Water keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.

Legacy of the Fifth

You can learn jutsu with the Medical Keyword. Jutsu you cast with the Medical keyword that inflicts a condition, can instead inflict an equal number of ranks of Drained.

description.value:
1st Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.

Amplified Defense

You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.

Amplified Flames

Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.

Amplified Retaliation

The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Agile Fist

The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.

Shurikenjutsu

The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

15th Level Clan Feature

You foresee victory in the movements of your enemies, even without the Sharingan.

As a bonus action, you can initiate your Crimson Aura, radiating a pulsing aura of chakra, radiating outwards from you in a 20-foot radius, centered on you. You can maintain this Crimson Aura for 1 minute, after which you cannot activate your aura until you complete a long rest.

While your aura is active you gain the following benefits;

Exploit Opening. Creatures that make attacks while in your aura, triggers attacks of opportunities from you. The first attack of opportunity you make against a creature, per round doesn’t consume your reaction.

Scan the Perimeter. Creatures that begin or end their turn within this radius, reveal themselves to you. You become aware of one statistic from a hostile creature between their AC, one saving throw bonus of your choice, or one special ability, attack or trait the creature has, that is unique to it.

Redirection. Once per turn, when a hostile creature you can see declares an attack against you while another hostile creature is within your aura, you can spend your reaction to force another hostile creature within your aura to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being forced to interpose the attack on a failed save.

description.value:
11th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha’s affinity to fire release isn’t just associated with offensive fire release, but in how they move, fight and counter. Their passion burns bright, igniting the embers of ambition in all others. When you activate your Sharingan, you can select 2 of the listed abilities, gaining them for the duration of this combat. You can use your selected abilities, once per turn. You cannot use more than one of these abilities as part of the same trigger;

Blazing Set Up. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or jutsu you cast of B-Rank or lower, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your Bonus action to mark all affected creatures until the end of your next turn. The next time a marked creature takes damage from yourself or one of your allies that you can see, you can detonate the mark, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the marked creature.

After-Image Assault. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your reaction to force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, until the start of your next turn, attacks against you from the affected creature is at disadvantage. If the affected creature deals damage to you through this effect, you can choose to select a space within 10 feet of yourself, and teleport to that space as you try to create distance between yourself and the enemy.

Ricochet Technique. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or 1 Bonus action to select a second creature within 20-feet of the original target. Remake your attack roll, targeting the second creature. On a hit, you deal half damage to the second target but apply the original attacks effects to the second target as well.

Critical Refocus. Once per turn, when a creature critically fails their saving throw resisting a Genjutsu you cast, you regain 1 Ocular Charge, per creature that critically failed.

Commanding Gaze. Once per turn, in place of an attack granted by the Attack action, you can gaze into the eyes of a non-blinded enemy you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge and they make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, you can imprint one of the following subconscious commands into them. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Command, Disarm. The affected creature, at the beginning or end of their turn, your choice, throws their weapon 30 + 5 times their strength of dexterity modifier in feet away from themselves in a direct of your choice.

Command, Retarget. When the affected creature targets a creature it can see, it must target a different creature it can see, even if that creature is its own ally.

description.value:
3rd Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the Hidden Leaf Village’s 2 great dojutsu. The Sharingan is an eye of extreme potential and flexibility. You gain access to the Sharingan. When you enter initiative, you can activate your Sharingan which lasts until the end of combat. Your Sharingan grants some passive bonuses, but you also has evolutions that can elevate it into a tool that represents you. Alternatively, you can activate your Sharingan as a bonus action and remains active for 1 minute.

You begin with 1 Ocular Evolution which you can use while your Sharingan is active. You can use these abilities by spending Ocular Charges. You have a number of Ocular Charges equal to 1+ your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Ocular Evolutions at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. You regain all spent Ocular Charges when you complete a rest.

| #### Sharingan / Reflex Amp / Your Sharingan grants you the following bonuses; / Chakra Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Chakra Sight. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Enemy Reading. You gain a rank of mastery to the following skill-based action; See Through Lies, Sense Motive, and Search. You can also use the aforementioned skill-actions as a bonus action. / Eye of Insight. When you take the Read the Enemy skill action, you gain a +4 bonus to the check. |

Sharingan Dodge

You can perceive an attacks target before it would ever land. Once per turn, while you are not grappled or prone, when you take damage from an attack or make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Ocular Charges to gain a rank of mastery to your AC or saving throw until the start of your next turn. This bonus does not stack with itself. When you reach 7th level, you instead gain 2 ranks of mastery.

Beginning at 15th level, you can choose to instead spend 3 Ocular Charges to cause the triggering attack to miss or automatically succeed the triggering saving throw.

Rewrite History

You place your allies under a helpful visual spell. As a reaction to an allied creature failing a saving throw, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge, allowing them to reroll. If they still fail, you can spend 2 additional Ocular Charges to make them remake their saving throw again. If they fail still, you can spend +1 additional Ocular Charge forcing them to remake the saving throw.

Hypnotic Eye

Your Sharingan can impart minor illusions onto enemies. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Ocular Charges you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that isn’t blind, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save they become either Berserk, Charmed, or Confused for the next minute. An affected creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success. On a success the target creature gains immunity to this evolution for the next 10 minutes.

Ocular Jutsu Augmentation

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent knowledge of how to better manipulate jutsu you cast. By spending 2 Ocular Charge as part of casting a Jutsu, you cast it without the Hand Sign (HS) or Chakra Molding (CM) components.

Sharingan Copy

The Sharingan is known as the copy wheel eye, capable of reading, translating and imprinting the process of how to use a jutsu or ability it saw onto your brain.

As a reaction to a creature, you can see casting a Jutsu with either the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components, but doesn’t have the Hijutsu keyword, you can spend 3 Ocular Charges to imprint the jutsu cast into your mind. The imprinted jutsu must be no more than the highest rank jutsu known based on your level. If you imprint a jutsu that has a nature release that you do not have an affinity for, increase that jutsu’s cost by an amount based on its rank. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +6, B-Rank: +8, A-Rank: +10, S-Rank: +12).

This jutsu is added to a special list known as your Imprint List. Your Imprint List is similar to your known jutsu list in which you can cast jutsu from it as if it’s on your known jutsu list, but with some specific rules.

You cannot cast jutsu on your Imprint List unless your Sharingan is active.

You can have 2 imprinted jutsu on your Imprint List. This increases to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.

Sharingan: Genjutsu!

The Sharingan is a weapon so potent that enemies know to never look you in the eye, else you place a spell upon them.

When you gain this Evolution and when you complete a rest of any type, select 2 Genjutsu you qualify for, of a rank you can cast based on your level, that has a casting time of 1 Action or Bonus Action. The chosen jutsu become known as Memorized Illusions, which are imprinted upon your Sharingan. You can imprint the same Memorized Illusion twice. Each imprint is treated as its own slot. Once you cast a Memorized Illusion it is spent and is no longer imprinted until you complete a short or long rest.

As an Action on your turn, you can activate this evolution, spending 2 Ocular Charges to cast one of the imprinted jutsu from your Sharingan. The jutsu’s range becomes 30 feet and you must be able to maintain eye contact with them for its casting. Casting this jutsu does not reveal your location or break stealth.

Increase the number of Memorized Illusions you can have by +1 when you reach 7th and 11th level.

Genjutsu Counter

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent awareness of Genjutsu and even the ability to dispel them. Genjutsu, whose DC is equal to or less than your passive Illusion skill or your Genjutsu Save DC (Whichever is higher) are those that you become aware of. Genjutsu you are aware of radiate a misty haze. If a creature is under the effect of a Genjutsu you are aware of the radiate this haze. By spending a Bonus action, you can perform the Identify Genjutsu skill action on a Genjutsu you are aware of.

As an Action by spending 1 Ocular Charge or bonus action by spending 2 Ocular Charges, while you an allied or willing creature is under the effects of a Genjutsu, you can make an Ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier, vs the DC of the Genjutsu affecting the target. On a success, you Dispel the afflicting Genjutsu.

If you are aware of the Genjutsu, you can instead make an Illusions check in place of an ability check.

3rd Level Clan Feature

Mutated Trait: Sharingan

You fail to manifest the clans Dojutsu. This absence was possible, but you expected this. Something inside warned you. And so, you trained until your technique and skill rivaled Uchiha with their Sharingan, even surpassing them in some areas. When you gain this feature mutation, you master two secret battle stances, taught to Uchiha incapable of awakening the Sharingan. The Flaming Spark chakra stance and the Blazing Fan Bukijutsu stance, of which you can benefit from both at the same time. If you have the Agile Fist adaptation, you can benefit from it, and either Flaming Spark or Blazing Fan, but never all three. As part of gaining this mutation, you also gain access to an Uchiha clan designed weapon a Gunbai Fan.

Flaming Spark. You build flaming chakra in your lungs until each word you speak is followed by spark of ember or whisps of smoke. You can enter this stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits;

As an Action, you can perform the Flame Flower attack. Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attack with Flame Flower.

When you cast a Jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, you become Enflamed until the end of your next turn. While Enflamed, attacks you make that would deal fire damage gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range.

Flame Flower. Make ranged Jutsu attack, using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, spitting a ball of flame that deals 2d6+2 fire damage on a hit and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, increase the damage dealt by 1d6+1

Blazing Fan. You take hold of your clans weapon of choice, the Gunbai fan. While wielding a Gunbai Fan, you can enter this stance as a bonus action. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;

The Gunbai Fan gains 1 rank of the Blocking property.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can make two attacks with the Gunbai Fan, as part of the Attack action.

As an Action, you can perform the Fanned Wind attack.

As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can perform the Uchiha Return.

Fanned Wind. You swipe your fan, creating a massive wave of force. All creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you must make a Strength saving throw, vs your highest jutsu save DC, taking [Weapon Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and being pushed back 20 feet on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, when you use this attack, you can choose to increase the size of the cone by 10-feet or the damage dealt by + [Weapon Damage].

Uchiha Return. You swipe your fan, initiating a Clash, using your highest skill between Ninshou, Martial Arts or Chakra Control.

If you take this mutation, you must also take the Heightened Battle Sense Uchiha mutation.

On a success, you Dispel the afflicting Genjutsu.

description.value:
The Sharingan is known as the copy wheel eye, capable of reading, translating and imprinting the process of how to use a jutsu or ability it saw onto your brain.

As a reaction to a creature, you can see casting a Jutsu with either the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components, but doesn’t have the Hijutsu keyword, you can spend 3 Ocular Charges to imprint the jutsu cast into your mind. The imprinted jutsu must be no more than the highest rank jutsu known based on your level. If you imprint a jutsu that has a nature release that you do not have an affinity for, increase that jutsu’s cost by an amount based on its rank. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +6, B-Rank: +8, A-Rank: +10, S-Rank: +12).

This jutsu is added to a special list known as your Imprint List. Your Imprint List is similar to your known jutsu list in which you can cast jutsu from it as if it’s on your known jutsu list, but with some specific rules.

You cannot cast jutsu on your Imprint List unless your Sharingan is active.

You can have 2 imprinted jutsu on your Imprint List. This increases to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.

Sharingan: Genjutsu!

The Sharingan is a weapon so potent that enemies know to never look you in the eye, else you place a spell upon them.

When you gain this Evolution and when you complete a rest of any type, select 2 Genjutsu you qualify for, of a rank you can cast based on your level, that has a casting time of 1 Action or Bonus Action. The chosen jutsu become known as Memorized Illusions, which are imprinted upon your Sharingan. You can imprint the same Memorized Illusion twice. Each imprint is treated as its own slot. Once you cast a Memorized Illusion it is spent and is no longer imprinted until you complete a short or long rest.

As an Action on your turn, you can activate this evolution, spending 2 Ocular Charges to cast one of the imprinted jutsu from your Sharingan. The jutsu’s range becomes 30 feet and you must be able to maintain eye contact with them for its casting. Casting this jutsu does not reveal your location or break stealth.

Increase the number of Memorized Illusions you can have by +1 when you reach 7th and 11th level.

description.value:
1st Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.

Amplified Defense

You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.

Amplified Flames

Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.

Amplified Retaliation

The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Agile Fist

The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.

Shurikenjutsu

The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
