description.value:
Ketsuki stands in the middle of the arena, his rival standing opposite to him. “How are you still standing? I've closed so many of your Chakra points. Just fall over and give up already Ketsuki!” his rival cried out. Ketsuki, stumbling but resisting to fall over, begins to weave hand seals. “I don’t back down! You of all people should know that by now!” he screams as he finishes his hand seals and creates a wave of Fire from the ground as it rolls towards his rival, overcoming him and defeating him as the crowds from the chunin arena screams in excitement.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 6 excerpt.

Never Backing Down

The Uzumaki Clan was formerly a prominent clan in the whirlpool country. Since its destruction, most of its members have resided in Konoha. Despite its past demise, over 100 years after the Fourth Shinobi World War the clan is once again active and prominent in the land of Fire. Uzumaki's skill with Fuinjutsu earned them both respect and fear throughout the ninja world. Uzumaki naturally possess incredibly strong life-forces. As such, they have very long lifespans and likewise age slower.

Uzumaki Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Cha

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Chakra Control, Ninshou

Uzumaki Sealing Techniques: The Uzumaki have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Uzumaki Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Overwhelming Determination: Jutsu you create using the Creating a Jutsu rules (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu) increases the maximum number of effects they can have by +1.

Uzumaki Features

Wellspring of Chakra

1st Level Clan Feature

The Uzumaki’s are known for their unmatched stamina and chakra reserves. Increase your Chakra point total by 2. Every level thereafter, increase your chakra point total by 2.

Additionally, this reserve of chakra stabilizes within you as pockets of self-energizing stores of chakra. This reserve of Chakra can be call upon and is known as Spiral Cells, of which you have 2. Once per turn, at the beginning of your turn, while you are not incapacitated or have ranks of Sealed you can call on this energy and spend 1 Spiral Cell. When you do, you gain 4 Temporary Chakra points. You regain spent Spiral Cells when you complete a rest.

Beginning at 7th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 4. Also, when you would take chakra damage or gain ranks of a Mental or Sensory condition you can spend 1 Spiral Cell to reduce the damage taken by an amount equal to your level or ranks of the condition gained to 0.

Beginning at 11th level, increase the Temporary Chakra points gained to 6.

Beginning at 15th level, increase the total number of Spiral Cells you have to 6.

Binding Chains

1st Level Clan Feature

The blood of the Uzumaki has crystalized and come to bear within you. You can manifest Chains of Binding. A special technique born of special fuinjutsu techniques inherent to your bloodline. These Chains of Binding manifest themselves as chakra-based chains of your description, manifesting themselves from your chakra core, but protruding from your body in a way you describe (from your back, your arms, belly, shoulders, etc.).

As a bonus action you can manifest these chains for 1 minute, by entering your Binding Chain chakra stance. Unlike other chakra stances, you can benefit from this chakra stance and either a Taijutsu stance or a Bukijutsu stance, at the same time.

When you enter this stance, you gain the following benefits;

You gain the Seal Break benefit from Uzumaki clan Hijutsu you cast.

When you take the attack action, you can choose to instead make either a Binding Chain or Striking Chain attack. These attacks use you’re your highest jutsu attack bonus.

Binding Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains encircle them. On a hit, you deal half the listed damage and once per turn, make an affected creature make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being Sealed on a failure. Beginning at 7th level, you can increase the number of creatures you can target with this attack to 2. Beginning at 15th level, this increases to 3.

Striking Chain. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack against a creature you can see, as your chains strike out, dealing the listed melee or ranged damage on a hit. You can replace up to two attacks you would make as part of the Attack action with this attack. Beginning at 7th level, attacks against a Grappled or Prone creature is always at advantage. Beginning at 15th level, you can pick one physical damage type, in addition to chakra damage dealing both at the same time.

Melee: 1d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier in Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 + your Jutsu ability modifier at 11th level.

Ranged: 30 feet, 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing or Chakra damage. This increases to 2d8 at 11th level.

Swirling Seals

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your binding chains aren’t the only secret technique passed down through the Uzumaki clan. You also learn to prepare special sealing formulas known only to your clan. These formulas are places onto chakra seals, turning them into Spiral Tags. Spiral Tags are special tags that can apply to damage dealt with the Binding Chain clan feature, as part of casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu or even following its effect text.

You can use no more than one Spiral Tags per turn. You begin with 2 known Spiral Tags. You gain an additional one at 7th and 11th levels. A Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If you would use a Spiral Tag that requires a saving throw as part of a Hijutsu you cast that also forces a saving throw, you pick which saving throw to use, following both effects on a success or failure.

Bound Inscription. As part of damage dealt or a creature failing a saving throw you can affix a Spiral Tag to the affected creature for the next minute. Alternatively, as a Bonus action, you can affix it to a willing creature, object or surface, which lasts for 24 hours. While affixed, and you are within at least 1 mile of the Spiral Tag, you can sense and hear creatures within 15 feet of the affixed location, enough to target them as if you could see them. You can make Binding Chain attacks or cast Uzumaki Hijutsu, having them originate from the tags affixed location.

Barrier Reverse Technique. As part of damage dealt with an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, against a creature with ranks of Sealed, you can have the binding formula overwritten. Affected creatures with ranks of sealed must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the Sealed condition gains an additional effect for the next minute; A Sealed creature suffers a -1 penalty to their AC for every rank they have, but they lose one rank of sealed at the end of each of their turns.

Sealing Cage. As an Action, you can select one creature you can see, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw as they are enveloped by chains of binding, like a globe or orb. On a failed save, they are captured inside of the dome until the end of your next turn. While inside the globe they are under total cover, and blinded. They cannot be targeted or affected by hostile effects and cannot take hostile action. While within the dome they cannot mold chakra. By spending a Full-Turn Action, you can extend the duration until the end of your following turn. A creature trapped inside this dome can escape by spending their Action, making a Strength saving throw, shattering the dome on a success.

Draining Seals. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Weakened on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Warding Seal. As a bonus action, you can mark a willing creature other than yourself, that you can see within 30 feet of you with a ward. A creature marked with this ward gains a rank of Mastery to their AC and a +1 bonus to their saving throws. While you have a creature marked in this way, this counts as concentrating on a jutsu of C-Rank.

Rebuking Seal. As part of making an attack granted by the Binding Chain feature, or casting an Uzumaki Hijutsu that deals damage, you can force an affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Concussed on a failed save. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

Gut Feeling

7th Level Clan Feature

Your clans instincts are legendary. So much so that this gut feeling is almost like a second bloodline trait. Your intuition sharpens your reactions and your read on people and your sense for traps.

While conscious, you cannot be surprised by hidden creatures. If one or more of your allies are surprised, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative, for each surprised allied creature.

Additionally, when a creature makes a Deception check against you, your GM treats your passive Insight as +5 higher.

If you would attempt the See through lies skill action, you make the check using either Constitution or Charisma. If you would beat the contested check by 5 or more, you gain a Will of Fire. You can gain a Will of Fire in this way, once per long rest.

Warding Network

11th Level Clan Feature

You sketch binding seals into the air, creating ninjutsu like effects without weaving a single hand sign.

Once per turn, as a bonus action or as part of casting an Jutsu with the Fuinjutsu keyword, you can manifest a Spiral Ward at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. This ward looks like a piece of paper with a special sealing formula only possible via Uzumaki clan techniques. You can maintain up to 2 wards at once, and a creature can only ever benefit from one ward at a time, choosing which ward they want to benefit from if ever in 2 auras at once. You select which type of ward you want to apply from those listed at the end of this feature.

You count as maintaining concentration on a Ninjutsu of B-Rank, no matter how many wards you have active. Wards last until dispelled or you end concentration on them. Each ward emanates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on the point it occupies;

Aegis: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their AC.

Clarity: All allied creatures in the affected area gain a rank of mastery to their first saving throw they make per round.

Anchor: Hostile creatures that would teleport while within 1-mile of this anchor, must make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, teleporting into a space within the affected area on a failure.

Spiraling Chains

15th Level Clan Feature

You bind battlefields onto you. A living sigil of control or domination. The arena is yours to command.

As a Bonus Action, you can place a binding seal onto yourself, and the ground, at a point you can reach, which remains for the next minute. The sigil, releases a 120-foot radius aura centered on the point. The edges of the aura has binding chains at its perimeter.

For the duration, attacks made with the Binding Chain feature or jutsu you cast with the Fuinjutsu keyword, can target any creature within this radius, even if you cannot see them, so long as you are aware of them and they are within the radius, they can be targeted, even if behind full cover.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

Clan Trait

Mutated Trait: Uzumaki Sealing Techniques

Beginning at character creation, select one jutsu of B-Rank or lower that you qualify for, adding this jutsu to your known list, but with some key differences. This jutsu now becomes your Original Technique. A jutsu that is unique to you and you alone. This version is one that only you can utilize to its fullest potential.

Its cost is set as Special (An amount equal to its rank: D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 9, B-Rank: 14, A-Rank: 20, S-Rank: 25)

Its base rank is set as Special (The Highest Rank you can cast, based on your level), and can only be cast at its base rank.

If it deals damage, reduce the amount of damage dice it has by an amount equal to its rank. As its rank grows based on your level (bullet point 2) return half the reduced damage dice rounded down for each rank. Once its base rank matches its original rank, it loses the damage dice penalty. (D-Rank: 0, C-Rank: -2, B-Rank: -4)

It gains the Hijutsu keyword.

Beginning at character creation, you can select 2 effects from the Jutsu Creation System (See Chapter 7: Adventuring & Missions, Learning/Creating A Jutsu), from the section that has a matching jutsu discipline as your select Jutsu (Ninjutsu, Genjutsu, Taijutsu/Bukijutsu), and adding them to your chosen jutsu. You cannot select the same effect more than once.

You cannot select the following effects; Lasting, Upcast, Damage, Empowered Damage, Multiple Strikes, Damage Reduction, Augmentation, Unavoidable or Mind Control.

Work with your GM on how these modifications make this selected jutsu function in the narrative. GM’s have final say over if an effect is compatible with your selected Jutsu.

If you take this mutation, you must also take any one 1st, 3rd, 11th and 15th level Uzumaki mutation.

description.value:
Lyo draws his blade just as quickly as his enemies drew theirs. Standing in the middle of the road, he realizes he has been surrounded by about a dozen adversaries. They assault him from the shadows throwing kunai and shuriken at him with relentless efficiency. He with his sword drawn begins to parry them all with ruthless focus. Each swing of his cuts, breaks, or deflects three or more weapons launched at him. He keeps up this defense before he realizes he can’t keep it up much longer. He takes a deep breath, as the weapons begin to strike his body, bouncing off of his skin as he dashes into the darkness. The singing of blades cutting through the air ring out as the fighting slowly quiets down to nothing more than a whisper. Lyo comes staggering out of the brush with his hand up in victory, showing his client that he is a lot tougher than he looks.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 4 excerpt.

The Basilisk’s Blessings

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever, Soren

The Hebi Clan also known as the Serpent Clan, or the Viper Clan were once slaves to a conniving master in the Land of Serpents. After escaping the shackles of oppression, they would become pivotal in their lands history, until being expelled, after the 3 Clan War, migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, finding themselves settled in the land of Fangs.

The Hebi has the kekkei genkai called Vipers Blood. This Bloodline allows all Hebi clansmen to produce a uniquely poison compound with themselves. This poison enables a Hebi to regenerate from harm, or severely envenom a foe. The Hebi are feared swordsmen, infiltration experts and alchemists within their new home, brining with them their religious faith of the Basilisk’s blessings.

Hebi Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Con

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Survival, Animal Handling

Weapon Proficiencies: You are proficient with Katana’s, Broadswords and Odachi. Tool Proficiencies: Poisoner’s Kit.

Hebi Clan Jutsu: The Hebi have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Hebi Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Constitution as its casting ability score.

Snake Speech: Hebi Clansmen are known for their affinity with snakes. You can communicate with and understand snakes and reptiles.

Snake Mimicry: Your heritage and history with your clans snakes has granted you enhanced senses. You have 10 feet of Tremor sense.

Hebi Features

Serpents Blood

1st Level Clan Feature

The Land of Fangs most noble family of shinobi. Born to a lineage of slaves, the Hebi vowed to never fall back into being any one persons servant, except for themselves. To ensure this, they would take and breed their own special lineage of highly venomous snakes, and harvest its venom, to ingest, drink and consume to build their bodies ability to produce it themselves.

As a child of this lineage, you carry a pool venom, called Viper Blood within your body, equal to 1 + proficiency bonus. You can spend this venom on features that call for it, regaining all spent Viper Blood when you complete a rest of any type.

Alternatively, your Viper Blood can be replenished once per turn, as a Bonus Action, by consuming a charge of a Poisoners Kit¸ or once per turn, when you deal melee damage to a creature with ranks of Envenomed you regain 1 Viper Blood.

Additionally, while you have Viper Blood, your body is constantly in a state of cellular regeneration, attempting to close wounds and heal sickness. While in combat, at the beginning of each of your turns, if you have 1 or more Viper Blood, you regain hit points equal to half your level. If you ever have 3 or more combined ranks of Physical or Elemental conditions, this regeneration is disabled until you are below this threshold. If you regain hit points from this effect, while at 0 hit points, you gain 1 failed death saving throw.

Serpent’s Coil

| Virulent / [Physical], [Elemental] / Your body has been compromised by the Hebi’s Viper Blood. Good Luck. / A Virulent creature cannot regain hit or chakra points. / A Virulent creature cannot gain temporary hit points or chakra points. / A Virulent creature reduces its damage die size by 1 step. If they use a d4, it instead becomes 1 damage, per dice that would be rolled. / Creatures that are resistant or immune to poison damage or the Envenomed condition are resistant or immune to the Virulent condition. / A creature can spend its action to make a DC 15 Constitution check to remove this condition. |

1st Level Clan Feature

The Hebi are prolific in their ability with a blade. Master swordsmen, their style of fighting is akin to an aggressive serpent coiling into itself and striking forward with its fangs erect. You learn the Serpent’s Coil Bukijutsu stance. This stance can only be used with weapons from the Blade Weapon Group.

As part of entering this stance and at the beginning of each of your turns while in this stance, you can spend 1 Vipers Blood to infuse your weapon with concentrated venom for the next minute. While your weapon is infused and you are in this stance, [Weapon Damage] you deal becomes poison, and it gains a rank of Mastery to their damage rolls. This increases to 2 ranks at 11th level.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Viper Strike or a Python Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Viper Blood, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Hebi Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Hebi Clan Hijutsu, gain their Serpent Coil effects.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Viper Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage], ignoring temporary hit points a creature may have. By spending 2 Viper Blood as part of this attack, you force them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they become Virulent until the beginning of your next turn. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute. Your [Weapon Damage] dealt as part of this Viper Strike increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Python Strike. Once per turn, make a weapon attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] If the target is currently Grappled, Restrained, or has their movement speed reduced by an effect you or an allied creature applied, this attack gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range. On a critical hit, by spending 1 Viper Blood, this attack gains the Deadly 2 property. This increases to Deadly 3 at 7th level and Deadly 4 at 15th level.

Venomous Technique

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Hebi Clan has spent generations cultivating their clans special breed of serpent and using its hyper potent venom to further enhance their clans station. The Hebi have developed a special organ that stores their Viper Blood. This organ with training, can be manipulated to express a series of techniques only possible for the Hebi called Venom Arts. The first of which all Hebi has is their ability to metabolize it to suppress extreme conditions they may experience.

If you end your turn with ranks of a Physical or Elemental condition, you can spend 1 Viper Blood, to make a Constitution saving throw vs a DC 15 + 1 for each Physical or Elemental condition rank you have. On a success, you remove 1 rank of an aforementioned condition.

You know one Venom Art of your choice, gaining an additional Venom Art at 7th and 15th levels. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC. If a Venom Art inflicts Virulent, it lasts until the beginning of your next turn unless otherwise stated. If an affected creature has ranks of Envenomed, you can choose to reduce those ranks to 0, and inflict Virulent, for the next minute.

Venomous Refresh

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 2 Viper Blood forcing it to cycle through your mind, washing over your brain and nervous system. When you do, select one Mental or Sensory condition you currently have, reducing its ranks by 2, except for the Sealed condition.

Venomous Regeneration

Once per turn, as a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend multiples of 2 Viper Blood, up to a max of 10. When you do, you roll 1 Hit die for every 2 Viper Blood spent. This does not spend your rolled hit die. You regain hit points equal to the result.

Venomous Augmentation

As a Bonus action, you can spend 2 Viper Blood, to circulate it throughout your muscles, having it act as a potent stimulant. Until the end of your next turn;

Your speed is increased by +10. This is increased by +10 at 7th and 15th levels.

Strength and Dexterity Checks you make gain a rank of Mastery. This increases to two ranks at 7th and 15th level.

Suppress the effects of Physical conditions you have for the duration.

Coiling – Black Mamba

You quickly drag your blade across your palm, drawing Viper Blood before swiping your finger across its flat side, drawing a Hebi Clan sealing circle, followed by a wide arcing feint followed by a direct thrust of the blade.

Make a melee Taijutsu attack, dealing your [Weapon Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw as the sealing circle is branded upon them binding and subjugating their wills. Select one of the listed effects between Basilisks Edict or Blood Override using their effects

Basilisks Edict: The sealed creature cannot willingly target any creature, other than the Hebi with either hostile or supportive effects, so long as they can see and are aware of the Hebi’s location. Effects the sealed creature uses that affect an area, now only affect the Hebi.

Blood Override: The sealed creature cannot cast Ninjutsu with the Hijutsu keyword of B-Rank or higher. And if they are a player character, their third level clan features are suppressed. If they are an adversary, they lose access to their clan traits/features for the duration.

Critical Success: Affected creatures is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature suffers the chosen effect, lasting until the beginning of your next turn.

The captain looks towards his fallen forces then to the shinobi. “Looks like you guys ran out of time.” The lone shinobi gloats before attacking the captain.

The Wolf’s Curse

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever

The Kuru Clan also known as the Shadow Clan, or the Dark Clan were seen as an influential family of Monks, prophets and fortune tellers from the Land of Wolves. After migrating south through the rest of the Shinobi world, their offspring began to pick up the ways of Ninshou and ninjutsu and has since settled in the Land of Claws.

The Kuru Clan have access to a unique Dojutsu known as the Miraigan, the Eyes of Prophecy. This Dojutsu carries the trait of limited foresight on a creature or object that they can see. They also learned how to harness the properties of Yin Chakra to a great effect allowing them to mold their chakra into almost any shape and even grant it different properties usually reserved for Nature release techniques without having to learn the appropriate Nature Release.

Kuru Traits

| #### Miraigan / Will Amp / Your Miraigan grants you the following benefits / Prophetic Vision. You cannot be surprised and hostile creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you for being unseen or Hidden. / Déjà vu. Once per turn, when a hostile creature casts a Jutsu while within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 Foresight, to make a Read the Enemy or Identify Jutsu check at No reaction or action cost. / Eyes of the Wolf. Your foresight extends into social and environmental situations. You gain a rank of Mastery to Insight checks and checks to Identify Jutsu and Read the Enemy. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th level and 3 ranks at 15th level. |

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Martial Arts

Dark Vision: You have Darkvision up to 60 Feet.

Black Wolf Techniques: The Kuru Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Kuru Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Yin Release Affinity: Reduce the downtime cost to learn and create Genjutsu by an amount equal to its rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5)

Kuru Features

Miraigan

1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

The Land of Claws single revered Dojutsu. The Miraigan is the Eyes that see through Fate. The Kuru do not see the world the way others do. They see the outcomes of actions before they are made, the results of mistakes before attempted. These eyes see tomorrow and when you see it, is when it changes. When you enter initiative, you can active your Miraigan, which lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can activate your Miraigan as a Bonus action, and it remains active for 10 minutes, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.

While active you can call upon a series of future visions, called Foresight. You can do this a number of times equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You use your Foresight for features that call for it, such as Prophesize. You regain spent Foresight when you complete a short or long rest.

Prophesize. You can glimpse into the future of an ally or yourself, before dragging yourself back into the preset to give them the knowledge they need to change it. Once per turn, while in combat, on your turn, by spending 1 Foresight, select one willing allied creature you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature gains a Fortune which lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until spent. A creature can only hold 1 Fortune at a time and they can spend it to do one of the following. If you grant Fortune to yourself it does not expire until spent, or combat ends;

Foretold Circumstance. Add 1d4 to an attack roll, Skill or Ability check, or saving throw they make.

Foretold Event. They gain an additional Reaction, which can only be used for feature or jutsu that trigger when they take damage.

1st Level Clan Feature

The Miraigan is but one trick the Kuru are capable of using. They are also able to utilize the Black Fang stance, a stance that blends their unique fighting style with their affinity for Yin Release. You learn the Black Fang Taijutsu stance, which uses your Clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits;

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and can deal either Bludgeoning, Necrotic or Psychic as you weave martial arts with illusions and sealing into each strike.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Past Strike or Future Strike. You can only use Past Strike or Future Strike once per turn each.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Past Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, visions of past combats overlap with this one, causing them to be Confused.

Future Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, at the beginning of their next turn, they are confronted with visions of future attacks from you that bind their chakra, inflicting 1 rank of Sealed.

Yin Release Adept

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Kuru has spent generations training and mastering both their Miraigan’s ability to see the future and their unique ability to manifest their variant of Yin Release. This special variant of Yin Release allows them to emulate the properties of other Nature Releases without ever having to carry their affinities. If you cast a Jutsu with a Nature Release keyword, you can choose to have it lose that Nature Release keyword, and gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that Jutsu’s Casting. Otherwise, Jutsu you cast, can gain the Yin Release keyword as part of that jutsu’s casting. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Yin Release. This jutsu’s damage type becomes Necrotic or Psychic. Additionally, if the jutsu could trigger any of the listed secondary effects found at the end of this section, that effect is replaced with the following; If the triggering jutsu forces a saving throw and the affected creature fails this saving throw, they are marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn. If the triggering jutsu doesn’t force a saving throw, then one of the affected creatures must make a Charisma saving throw vs the Jutsu’s save DC, being marked with a Yin-Seal until the end of your next turn on a failure.

Earth Release: Creates difficult terrain or inflicts a Condition.

Wind Release: Swirl effect.

Fire Release: Flat damage modifier added as part of the damage calculation.

Water Release: Benefit for being near a source of Water.

Lightning Release: Overcharge effect.

Additionally, you have access to a deep pool of secret Kuru clan techniques known as Yin Arts, of which you know 1. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels.

Dual Sight

You learn to split your focus between today and tomorrow simultaneously. While your Miraigan is active, you can grant Fortune to two creature, rather than one when you use Prophesize. Though this causes you stress. You can now only use the Prophesize effect, once every other turn.

Prophetic Counter

You can now cycle between the future and the present between each step, strike and handsigns, but only while focusing on a single creature. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Counter ability.

Prophetic Counter. Once per turn, when a creature makes an attack targeting you and would score a hit, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to force them to remake their attack. If this would cause them to miss their attack, you can, as part of the same reaction take the Attack action targeting them.

Prophetic Weakness

You can now focus in on an enemies weaknesses and foresee their most critical openings. While your Miraigan is active, you gain the Prophetic Weakness ability

Prophetic Weakness. As a Bonus action you can spend 2 Foresight and select one creature you can see and foretell their weakness. Until the beginning of your next turn, they take +2 bonus damage from all sources. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level.

Prophetic Teamwork

You can use your Miraigan to foresee the best possible way to work with your team, by viewing multiple scenarios and stitching together a plan. When an allied creature within 30 Feet of you would deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 2 Foresight to target another allied creature within 30 feet, that can target the same hostile creature. They gain the Prophetic Teamwork special action until the beginning of their next turn.

Prophetic Teamwork. This special action can only be used when it is not your turn. You can use any feature, jutsu or Attack that takes an Action, targeting a hostile creature that has taken damage this turn from an allied creature.

Yin Release – Veil of mystery

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to share your visions with your foe, but only the ones you want to share. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, you can spend 1 Foresight, targeting them to conjure a Misfortune which can only be used against them once before the end of your next turn. You can only maintain 1 Misfortune at a time. You can spend Misfortune to achieve one of the following;

Foretold Despair. subtract 1d4 from an attack roll, Skill check or saving throw they make.

Foretold Failure. To nullify any one jutsu based bonus, benefit or effect that applies to them.

Yin Release – Chains of Causality

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to bind a vision of the future to your foe, making it their truth, their reality. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, each time they make a Weapon attack or cast a jutsu, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC for attacks you make against them, as each of these activities have been foreseen and it brings you closer to the destined strike you know to be true.

Beginning at 11th level, if your attack result would be 10 or higher than the AC of a Yin Sealed target, you treat that attack as a Critical hit.

Yin Release – Uncertain Future

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to obfuscate the assumptions and plans they just had, blinding them to their own desires. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, and they cast a jutsu or spends their Action, Bonus Action or Reaction while within 60 feet of a Kuru that can see them, that Kuru can spend their Reaction and spend 2 Foresight, forcing the Yin-Sealed creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs the Kuru’s highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the Yin-Sealed creature must perform an alternative Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or Jutsu with the same casting time, or they lose the Action they spent as the ability to perform that action is temporarily sealed.

Black Fang – Yin Palm Strike

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike with claws like a wolves jaw. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Yin Palm Strike.

Yin Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, breaking their spiritual center, but marking them with a Yin-Seal.

Black Fang – Future Denial

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at the temple of your foe. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Denial Palm Strike.

Denial Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a saving throw, using their associated jutsu modifier of the target discipline. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, fragmenting their memories. Select one casting discipline between Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu; and one rank between E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank, B-Rank and A-Rank, for the next minute they cannot cast jutsu of the select discipline and rank. A creature affected by this remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Black Fang – Theft of Time

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at where your foe believes they should be in time, replacing them with yourself and vice versa. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of an attack of opportunity, you can instead make a Time Theft Strike.

Time Theft Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you use your Yin chakra affinity to rip their belief that they belong, and delay it. You switch places with them in initiative at the end of their current turn or next turn, whichever occurs first. If this initiative movement would cause you to miss taking a turn, you instead immediately take your turn, and initiative continues selecting the creature that would have gone normally. If this initiative movement would cause you to take an additional turn this round, you skip that turn in initiative. Hostile creatures that would miss their turn due to this feature, act at the end of the initiative round. A hostile creature that would gain an additional turn as a result of this swap loses that turn instead.

On a failure, they face a fabricated moment of a false future they desire, becoming Stunned on a failure, until the end of their next turn. 7th Level Clan Feature

The Miraigan was born out of the search for truth, but was used to facilitate a war. A war whose scars still affect the Kuru to this day. The Kuru have learned to not ask the future what to do, but to instead ask what not to do.

While your Miraigan is active outside of combat, you can spend Foresight to briefly glimpse into the future to avoid mistakes and pitfalls your future self has already fallen for. For every 1 Foresight you spend, the GM can provide 1 hint relevant to your current situation, in the form of a short 1-to-2-word warning. These hints are never to tell you what to do, but to warn you against doing something, since your Miraigan shows you visions of failures, to help guide you to a successful future.

Okami of Midnight

11th Level Clan Feature

The clan of Monks, warriors and revolutionaries all exist at the same time within the past of the Kuru, but what is lost is the blessings of Kuroi, the first Alpha. You hope to embody their blessings, their pride and their forgotten memory, by inheriting his will, learning the Black Okami Form.

As a Bonus action, while you have both the Miraigan active and are in the Black Fang stance, you can spend 4 Foresight, to enter the Black Okami Form. Entering this form causes your Yin Chakra to tattoo itself across your skin, in tribalistic patterns as your eyes gain black markings around them, making your gaze more intense, like that of a wolf. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute, you become incapacitated or you are no longer in your Black Fang stance or your Miraigan isn’t active. Once you use this form, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

Eye of Prophecy

15th Level Clan Feature

Each time you blink, your Miraigan peers into the sea of possible futures. You are never certain what will happen, but you make certain to prevent the worst from every occurring.

When you roll initiative, and activate your Miraigan as part of it, it peers into 5 possible timelines. Roll the following dice and record each result separately: 1d20, 1d12, 1d8, 1d6, 1d4.

These results are called your Prophetic Pool for the duration of combat. You can use these results to replace die rolls made by creatures you can see, ally or hostile, when they roll a die or dice of the same size.

If a creature rolls multiple dice of the same size as part of the same effect, you can replace one of their die results with a recorded result from your Prophetic Pool as normal, but by spending 1 Foresight for every additional die you wish to replace with your Prophetic Pools result. Each replacement uses the same value.

Once you used your Prophetic Pool to replace a result, the used die size is exhausted until you next roll initiative.

While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, each time they make a Weapon attack or cast a jutsu, they suffer a -1 penalty to their AC for attacks you make against them, as each of these activities have been foreseen and it brings you closer to the destined strike you know to be true.

Beginning at 11th level, if your attack result would be 10 or higher than the AC of a Yin Sealed target, you treat that attack as a Critical hit.

Yin Release – Uncertain Future

You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to obfuscate the assumptions and plans they just had, blinding them to their own desires. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, and they cast a jutsu or spends their Action, Bonus Action or Reaction while within 60 feet of a Kuru that can see them, that Kuru can spend their Reaction and spend 2 Foresight, forcing the Yin-Sealed creature to make a Charisma saving throw vs the Kuru’s highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, the Yin-Sealed creature must perform an alternative Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or Jutsu with the same casting time, or they lose the Action they spent as the ability to perform that action is temporarily sealed.

Black Fang – Yin Palm Strike

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike with claws like a wolves jaw. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Yin Palm Strike.

Yin Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, breaking their spiritual center, but marking them with a Yin-Seal.

Black Fang – Future Denial

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at the temple of your foe. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Denial Palm Strike.

Denial Palm Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a saving throw, using their associated jutsu modifier of the target discipline. On a failure, you inject Yin chakra into them, fragmenting their memories. Select one casting discipline between Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu; and one rank between E-Rank, D-Rank, C-Rank, B-Rank and A-Rank, for the next minute they cannot cast jutsu of the select discipline and rank. A creature affected by this remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

Black Fang – Theft of Time

You focus Yin chakra into your palms and strike at where your foe believes they should be in time, replacing them with yourself and vice versa. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of an attack of opportunity, you can instead make a Time Theft Strike.

Time Theft Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, you use your Yin chakra affinity to rip their belief that they belong, and delay it. You switch places with them in initiative at the end of their current turn or next turn, whichever occurs first. If this initiative movement would cause you to miss taking a turn, you instead immediately take your turn, and initiative continues selecting the creature that would have gone normally. If this initiative movement would cause you to take an additional turn this round, you skip that turn in initiative. Hostile creatures that would miss their turn due to this feature, act at the end of the initiative round. A hostile creature that would gain an additional turn as a result of this swap loses that turn instead.

description.value:
Tye dashes into the enemy fortress full of rage and his blood boiling. “GIVE HER BACK!” he screams as his eyes glow with an emerald green hue. He swipes his hand towards an enemy guard, as a wave of Chakra leaps from it chopping them in half with a blade of Wind. The enemies quickly try to seal the doors within the fortress but find it difficult as the angry boy weaves hand seals and exhales a gale of slicing Wind that blows the layered doors apart. He continues further in, before he is confronted by the man he lost to prior. “You throw away the kindness I showed you before boy. You are a fool.” He barks. But Tye doesn’t budge, as Chakra begins to coat his body with enough potency to be visible to the naked eye. The man is caught off guard with the sudden change, but Tye doesn’t hesitate as he rushes in ready to tear this man in half.

—Nina Heroshi

Blood of the Dragon

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever

The Ryu Clan also known as the Dragon Clan were seen as a barbaric tribe of warriors, mercenaries and conquerors from the Land of Dragons. After the Three Clan War, the Land of Dragons would revolt, leading to a near genocide of the Ryu clan, causing their remnant to scatter and escape extinction. A group of these clansmen went south, learning the ways of Ninshou and has since settle in the Land of Mountains.

The Ryu has the unique bloodline simply called Blood of the Dragon or Ryuki, Draconic Chakra. This Bloodline allows all Clansmen to manifest a nature transformation at birth, but unlike normal nature transformations, this transformation is more savage, brutal, violent. Children cry fire, scream thunder and whine storms. Not enough to cause harm, but enough to show that this clan has a strong connection to nature transformations. This Kekkei Genkai also has a negative trait, that manifests in the younger members of the clan, being that their anger and rage is unmatched.

Ryu Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase (Select one):

Primal Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Con

Empyreal Dragon: +2 Str, +1 Con

Omen Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, Chakra Control

Dragon Kings Techniques: The Ryu Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Ryu Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Draconic Power: Ryu Hijutsu you cast cannot have their cost increased by hostile effects or conditions.

Ryu Features

Wrath of the Dragon

1st Level Clan Feature

Born with the blood of dragons running through your veins you have a natural affinity to one of 5 chakra transformations. Beginning at 1st level, Choose between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water or Lightning Release. You can learn and cast jutsu with the chosen release and all of your Ryu Clan jutsu gains the chosen keyword and deals the same damage as the chosen nature releases damage type unless otherwise stated.

This inherent connection the elements is possible through your clans unique bloodline heritage, Draconic Chakra. You have a number of Draconic Chakra equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Draconic Chakra for features and abilities that call for it, such as unleashing your Dragon’s Rage. You can regain 1 Draconic Chakra once per turn, when you inflict a hostile creature with your chosen nature releases associated condition. You regain all spent Draconic Chakra when you complete a rest of any type.

Also, as a Bonus Action you can spend 2 Draconic Chakra to enter your Dragon’s Rage. Your eyes shift colors and chakra like scales form over your skin. Both your scales and eyes are all a color that matches your Draconic Chakra (Brown = Earth, Emerald = Wind, Red = Fire, Blue = Water, Gold = Lightning). You can maintain your Dragon’s Rage for one minute. You can dismiss it at no action on your turn. If you have 3 or more ranks of Sealed, your Dragon’s Rage state forcibly ends.

Your Dragon’s Rage grows with you as you grow in level, beginning at 7th level, you can spend 4 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in the Dragon’s Rage state, to become Ascended. Beginning at 15th level, you can spend 6 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in your Ascended Dragon’s Rage state, to become Awakened.

Your [Unarmed Damage] damage type becomes your chosen nature releases damage type. / Wyrm Surge. Non Hijutsu you cast with your chosen nature release gains the Wyrm Surge Keyword as part of their casting. Jutsu with this keyword will always inflict 1 rank of their associated condition on a failed save or if the attack is a critical hit, unless the jutsu already inflicts the associated condition on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at15th level. Ryūken

1st Level Clan Feature

The Ryu clan has never fought with a tempered goal, or with modesty or with sportsmanship in mind. Their style of fighting was always desperate, ruthless and even a little underhanded. Their style embodies the ferocity of a starving dragon. You learn the Ryūken Taijutsu stance, which uses your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes a d6 and can deal Slashing or Piercing damage as you treat each hand as a claw or dragon fang.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Rending Strike or a Starving Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Rending Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage], and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, as you rend their defenses, until the beginning of your next turn. This increases to a 2 AC reduction at 7th level and a 3 AC reduction at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Starving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as Chakra damage, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you forcefully drain them of chakra, using your Draconic Chakra to tear it from them, like flesh on the bone. You gain 2 Temporary chakra, until the end of the current turn. This increases to 4 Temporary chakra at 7th level and 6 temporary chakra at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Tyrants Dominion

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your strength, unrivaled. Your savagery, unmatched. You fight better. You strike harder. You move faster. Everything that the suns light touches is yours. Your clan believed this in their past and part of you even believes it now. You express this in a series of Wyrm Arts. Special technique the Ryu clan demands its members master, to be prepared for the next clan war. You begin knowing two of these arts. You gain an additional one at 7th and 15th level. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Sovereigns Ascent

As a bonus action, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra while you are standing on the ground, you can strike the ground with enough force to send you airborne, covered in Draconic Chakra. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed until the end of your next turn as your slowed descent can be confused for flight.

Sovereigns Brutality

Combat for you feeds something deep inside you. Something primal. Instinctual. Conflict drives you, and that drive ignites your passion for battle like an engine. At the beginning of your turn, if you have taken damage since the end of your last turn, your brutality is magnified. Attacks you make against creatures with ranks of Elemental or Physical conditions, gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Sovereigns Coil

As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to roar, releasing a shockwave of Draconic Chakra, cracking the ground and shattering glass. This force is enough to stave off the force of jutsu. You trigger a Clash vs the triggering jutsu, using your Chakra control.

Sovereigns Momentum

As an Action, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to move forward in a 30-foot line, creating a vacuum of force, while covered in Draconic Chakra, passing through all creatures in your path. Make an unarmed attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all hostile creatures you passed through dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as normal. This unarmed attack can use your Rending Strike, Starving Strike or any Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art.

Ryūken – Cleaving Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons tail shredding through the ground and air. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Cleaving Strike.

Cleaving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, reduce their DR by 4, until the end of your next turn. This penalty increases to 6 at 7th and 8 at 15th levels and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Ryūken – Consuming Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons maw biting and gouging at its prey. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Consuming Strike.

Consuming Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature has one jutsu based effect of D-Rank or lower they are benefiting from dispelled as your Draconic Chakra eats away at it. The rank of jutsu this affects increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Ryūken – Rebelling Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons claw ripping and tearing at their assailant. Once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your unarmed attack range, you can make a Rebelling Strike.

Rebelling Strike. Make two unarmed attacks against the triggering creature, each dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit. If you hit at least once, you force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are pushed 20 feet back, fall prone and are Bruised and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Tyrants Focus

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Focus ability.

Tyrants Focus. You gain immunity to effects that would force you to treat allied creatures as hostile, or force you to target allied creatures with harmful effects. Additionally, you cannot be Charmed by a hostile creature while in combat.

Tyrants Ferocity

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Ferocity ability.

Tyrants Ferocity. When you score a critical hit against a creature with a jutsu based attack you make, you can make one Rending Strike, Starving Strike or Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art against the same creature.

Tyrants Hunger

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Hunger ability.

Tyrants Hunger. When you take damage from a jutsu with the associated nature release you chose as part of the Wrath of the Dragon clan feature, you can spend your reaction to consume some of it, like eating fire, lighting or stone, reducing the damage you take by 1 damage die and regaining Draconic Chakra equal to the rank of the triggering jutsu (D-Rank/C-Rank: 2, B-Rank/A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 6). Increase the damage you reduce by an additional damage die at 7th and 15th levels.

Wyrm Lords Ambition

7th Level Clan Feature

While the Ryu clan lost many things in the Three Clan War and its following exile. Its ambition for dominion over even the skies, has remained. By spending 1 minute focusing your Chakra outward, and spending 2 Draconic Chakra, you can extend your Draconic chakra to all willing allied creatures within 10 feet of you. Each creature gains draconic wings made of chakra that grants them 30 feet of flight for the next 10 minutes all linked to you. Once you use this feature to grant yourself or other creature flight, you cannot do so again until you complete a short or long rest.

If initiative is rolled while allied creatures are benefiting from this flight, at the beginning of their turns, they can choose to maintain or dismiss the wings. If they maintain it, they must continue to concentrate on them as if they are concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu. If they dismiss it, they float down slowly towards the ground.

Additionally, you learn to lean into the weight of your name. The stories commoners would speak of your families conquests would scare children and adults alike. When in a social encounter with a Non-combatant creature, such as a merchant, civilian, or minor official, revealing your clan heritage is enough to make one minor request without requiring a skill check, as they comply out of fear of what could happen if they don’t.

Any further requests require checks and skill-based actions as normal.

Dragon Kings Legacy

11th Level Clan Feature

The Ryu who stand today are descendants of the survivors of the Three Clan war. Those who survived the bloodiest 10-day conflict in the Northern Bestial Nations history. Your genes remember this blood feud and you have tapped into the methods of survival your ancestors used to make it through their conflict.

Lineage of Survival. You gain resistance to the condition your chosen nature release inflicts and if you begin your turn with ranks of Envenomed, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra, to reduce the associated ranks by 1.

Unbreakable Wyrm. All Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast that require concentration, gains the Stable keyword for their duration.

Bloodline of Violence. Once per turn, when you cast a Ryu Clan Hijutsu and gain its Dragon Rage effect, you regain 1 Draconic Chakra.

Defiance of Fate

15th Level Clan Feature

The Dragon seed in your soul has sprouted, awakening one of the Dragons of legend within you whose name has long since been lost to time. It has been nurtured by your trials, tribulations, struggles, failures and successes. Now that it lives within you, it refuses to allow fate to determine your destiny. You gain the following benefits;

Untamable. While in your Dragon’s Rage, you must now have 5 ranks of Sealed to have it forcefully ended.

Dragon Kings Decree. When initiative is rolled, you can spend multiples of 5 Draconic Chakra to issue a fate defying declaration, which lasts until the end of combat. Select the Decrees you want to evoke;

Attacks you make and damage you deal cannot be intercepted by Barriers or other creatures.

Once per combat, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you defy fate and remain at 1 Hit point and enter your Awakened, Dragon’s Rage state at no additional Draconic Chakra cost, removing all current conditions you have as part of its activation.

Effects that would change or replace your dice roll result instead always allows you to reroll, taking the higher result.

Born with the blood of dragons running through your veins you have a natural affinity to one of 5 chakra transformations. Beginning at 1st level, Choose between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water or Lightning Release. This inherent connection the elements is possible through your clans unique bloodline heritage, Draconic Chakra. You have a number of Draconic Chakra equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Draconic Chakra for features and abilities that call for it, such as unleashing your Dragon’s Rage. 1st Level Clan Feature

The Ryu clan has never fought with a tempered goal, or with modesty or with sportsmanship in mind. Their style of fighting was always desperate, ruthless and even a little underhanded. Their style embodies the ferocity of a starving dragon. You learn the Ryūken Taijutsu stance, which uses your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes a d6 and can deal Slashing or Piercing damage as you treat each hand as a claw or dragon fang.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Rending Strike or a Starving Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Rending Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage], and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, as you rend their defenses, until the beginning of your next turn. This increases to a 2 AC reduction at 7th level and a 3 AC reduction at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Starving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as Chakra damage, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you forcefully drain them of chakra, using your Draconic Chakra to tear it from them, like flesh on the bone. You gain 2 Temporary chakra, until the end of the current turn. This increases to 4 Temporary chakra at 7th level and 6 temporary chakra at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

description.value:
Vale sits holding her fallen ally in her arms. As the enemy surrounds her. “This is it, Uchiha. It’s over, there is no way to reconcile what you did. If you had just surrendered from the beginning, they would all be alive” the rogue shinobi says while placing his weapon on his shoulder looking down on her. Vale begins to look up at them, but something is different. Her eyes are red with additional tome in them. The rogue shinobi attack her but misses, she moves like she was a phantom, a ghost. She sees all of their movements before they even make them and will get vengeance for her fallen allies. She feels her weakness being the sole reason for their defeat and she will rectify it, if it's the last thing she does.

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 15 excerpt.

The Curse of Hatred

The Uchiha clan is one of the four noble clans of Konohagakure, reputed to be one of the village's strongest because of their Sharingan and natural battle prowess. After helping found Konoha decades ago, the Uchiha grew increasingly isolated from the village's affairs, culminating in most of their deaths during the Uchiha clan downfall. After the 4th great ninja war, they began to find footing and regrow. There are quite a few Uchiha now in the present day, though not as many who are shinobi.

Uchiha Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Dex or Int, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Insight, Pick one between: Ninshou, Martial Arts, Illusions

Fire Release Affinity: You have Fire Release affinity.

Uchiha Techniques: The Uchiha Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Uchiha Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Uchiha Features

Advanced Adaptation

1st Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.

Amplified Defense

You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.

Amplified Flames

Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.

Amplified Retaliation

The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Agile Fist

The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.

Shurikenjutsu

The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Sharingan

3rd Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the Hidden Leaf Village’s 2 great dojutsu. The Sharingan is an eye of extreme potential and flexibility. You gain access to the Sharingan. When you enter initiative, you can activate your Sharingan which lasts until the end of combat. Your Sharingan grants some passive bonuses, but you also has evolutions that can elevate it into a tool that represents you. Alternatively, you can activate your Sharingan as a bonus action and remains active for 1 minute.

You begin with 1 Ocular Evolution which you can use while your Sharingan is active. You can use these abilities by spending Ocular Charges. You have a number of Ocular Charges equal to 1+ your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Ocular Evolutions at 7th, 11th and 15th levels. You regain all spent Ocular Charges when you complete a rest.

| #### Sharingan / Reflex Amp / Your Sharingan grants you the following bonuses; / Chakra Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Chakra Sight. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level. / Enemy Reading. You gain a rank of mastery to the following skill-based action; See Through Lies, Sense Motive, and Search. You can also use the aforementioned skill-actions as a bonus action. / Eye of Insight. When you take the Read the Enemy skill action, you gain a +4 bonus to the check. |

Sharingan Dodge

You can perceive an attacks target before it would ever land. Once per turn, while you are not grappled or prone, when you take damage from an attack or make a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw, you can spend 2 Ocular Charges to gain a rank of mastery to your AC or saving throw until the start of your next turn. This bonus does not stack with itself. When you reach 7th level, you instead gain 2 ranks of mastery.

Beginning at 15th level, you can choose to instead spend 3 Ocular Charges to cause the triggering attack to miss or automatically succeed the triggering saving throw.

Rewrite History

You place your allies under a helpful visual spell. As a reaction to an allied creature failing a saving throw, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge, allowing them to reroll. If they still fail, you can spend 2 additional Ocular Charges to make them remake their saving throw again. If they fail still, you can spend +1 additional Ocular Charge forcing them to remake the saving throw.

Hypnotic Eye

Your Sharingan can impart minor illusions onto enemies. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Ocular Charges you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that isn’t blind, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save they become either Berserk, Charmed, or Confused for the next minute. An affected creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success. On a success the target creature gains immunity to this evolution for the next 10 minutes.

Ocular Jutsu Augmentation

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent knowledge of how to better manipulate jutsu you cast. By spending 2 Ocular Charge as part of casting a Jutsu, you cast it without the Hand Sign (HS) or Chakra Molding (CM) components.

Sharingan Copy

The Sharingan is known as the copy wheel eye, capable of reading, translating and imprinting the process of how to use a jutsu or ability it saw onto your brain.

As a reaction to a creature, you can see casting a Jutsu with either the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components, but doesn’t have the Hijutsu keyword, you can spend 3 Ocular Charges to imprint the jutsu cast into your mind. The imprinted jutsu must be no more than the highest rank jutsu known based on your level. If you imprint a jutsu that has a nature release that you do not have an affinity for, increase that jutsu’s cost by an amount based on its rank. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +6, B-Rank: +8, A-Rank: +10, S-Rank: +12).

This jutsu is added to a special list known as your Imprint List. Your Imprint List is similar to your known jutsu list in which you can cast jutsu from it as if it’s on your known jutsu list, but with some specific rules.

You cannot cast jutsu on your Imprint List unless your Sharingan is active.

You can have 2 imprinted jutsu on your Imprint List. This increases to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.

Sharingan: Genjutsu!

The Sharingan is a weapon so potent that enemies know to never look you in the eye, else you place a spell upon them.

When you gain this Evolution and when you complete a rest of any type, select 2 Genjutsu you qualify for, of a rank you can cast based on your level, that has a casting time of 1 Action or Bonus Action. The chosen jutsu become known as Memorized Illusions, which are imprinted upon your Sharingan. You can imprint the same Memorized Illusion twice. Each imprint is treated as its own slot. Once you cast a Memorized Illusion it is spent and is no longer imprinted until you complete a short or long rest.

As an Action on your turn, you can activate this evolution, spending 2 Ocular Charges to cast one of the imprinted jutsu from your Sharingan. The jutsu’s range becomes 30 feet and you must be able to maintain eye contact with them for its casting. Casting this jutsu does not reveal your location or break stealth.

Increase the number of Memorized Illusions you can have by +1 when you reach 7th and 11th level.

Genjutsu Counter

Your Sharingan grants you some inherent awareness of Genjutsu and even the ability to dispel them. Genjutsu, whose DC is equal to or less than your passive Illusion skill or your Genjutsu Save DC (Whichever is higher) are those that you become aware of. Genjutsu you are aware of radiate a misty haze. If a creature is under the effect of a Genjutsu you are aware of the radiate this haze. By spending a Bonus action, you can perform the Identify Genjutsu skill action on a Genjutsu you are aware of.

As an Action by spending 1 Ocular Charge or bonus action by spending 2 Ocular Charges, while you an allied or willing creature is under the effects of a Genjutsu, you can make an Ability check using your highest jutsu ability modifier, vs the DC of the Genjutsu affecting the target. On a success, you Dispel the afflicting Genjutsu.

If you are aware of the Genjutsu, you can instead make an Illusions check in place of an ability check.

Blood of the Fan

7th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are well known in many shinobi circles as having stern, cool, and commanding presences. Their proximity to other capable shinobi makes it difficult to take control of a situation while an Uchiha is present.

When a non-allied creature attempts to make an Intimidation or Persuasion check against another creature while you are present, you can spend a reaction and impose disadvantage on their check. Once you use this feature you cannot do so again for 10 minutes or you succeed an Intimidation check, recharging it.

Fanning The Flame

11th Level Clan Feature

Uchiha’s affinity to fire release isn’t just associated with offensive fire release, but in how they move, fight and counter. Their passion burns bright, igniting the embers of ambition in all others. When you activate your Sharingan, you can select 2 of the listed abilities, gaining them for the duration of this combat. You can use your selected abilities, once per turn. You cannot use more than one of these abilities as part of the same trigger;

Blazing Set Up. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with an attack or jutsu you cast of B-Rank or lower, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your Bonus action to mark all affected creatures until the end of your next turn. The next time a marked creature takes damage from yourself or one of your allies that you can see, you can detonate the mark, dealing 3d6 fire damage to the marked creature.

After-Image Assault. Once per turn, when you deal damage to a hostile creature, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or your reaction to force them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, until the start of your next turn, attacks against you from the affected creature is at disadvantage. If the affected creature deals damage to you through this effect, you can choose to select a space within 10 feet of yourself, and teleport to that space as you try to create distance between yourself and the enemy.

Ricochet Technique. Once per turn, when you make a ranged attack, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge or 1 Bonus action to select a second creature within 20-feet of the original target. Remake your attack roll, targeting the second creature. On a hit, you deal half damage to the second target but apply the original attacks effects to the second target as well.

Critical Refocus. Once per turn, when a creature critically fails their saving throw resisting a Genjutsu you cast, you regain 1 Ocular Charge, per creature that critically failed.

Commanding Gaze. Once per turn, in place of an attack granted by the Attack action, you can gaze into the eyes of a non-blinded enemy you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do, you can spend 1 Ocular Charge and they make a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, you can imprint one of the following subconscious commands into them. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of your next turn.

Command, Disarm. The affected creature, at the beginning or end of their turn, your choice, throws their weapon 30 + 5 times their strength of dexterity modifier in feet away from themselves in a direct of your choice.

Command, Retarget. When the affected creature targets a creature it can see, it must target a different creature it can see, even if that creature is its own ally.

Command, Telegraph. The affected creature telegraphs their next attack or jutsu unconsciously yelling out its name and its effects and who they are targeting and why. You and all allied creatures that can see and hear them gains the benefit of a successful Read the Enemy.

Command, Taunt. The affected creature gains disadvantage on attacks targeting creatures other than yourself. Additionally, creatures other than yourself treat the affected creatures save DC as -2 lower unless you are part of the area of effect or making the same saving throw from the same effect.

Crimson Sovereign

15th Level Clan Feature

You foresee victory in the movements of your enemies, even without the Sharingan.

As a bonus action, you can initiate your Crimson Aura, radiating a pulsing aura of chakra, radiating outwards from you in a 20-foot radius, centered on you. You can maintain this Crimson Aura for 1 minute, after which you cannot activate your aura until you complete a long rest.

While your aura is active you gain the following benefits;

Exploit Opening. Creatures that make attacks while in your aura, triggers attacks of opportunities from you. The first attack of opportunity you make against a creature, per round doesn’t consume your reaction.

Scan the Perimeter. Creatures that begin or end their turn within this radius, reveal themselves to you. You become aware of one statistic from a hostile creature between their AC, one saving throw bonus of your choice, or one special ability, attack or trait the creature has, that is unique to it.

Redirection. Once per turn, when a hostile creature you can see declares an attack against you while another hostile creature is within your aura, you can spend your reaction to force another hostile creature within your aura to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, being forced to interpose the attack on a failed save.
